item.title: Google Dismantles x.cpe Botnet on 1.3M Android TV Boxes
item.description: Google’s Threat Intelligence Group dismantled the x.cpe botnet, exposing 1.3 million Android TV boxes and underscoring supply‑chain security flaws.
